title: Insufficient PBKDF2 iterations
remediation: Use at least 10000 iterations and tune upward for the deployment environment.

evidence.code: PBKDF2HMAC(algorithm = getattr(hashes, hashfunc.upper()), length = keylen, salt = salt, iterations = iterations, backend = backend)

title: Insecure randomness for crypto
message: Cryptographic material originates from a non-cryptographic random source.
remediation: Use the platform cryptographic random generator.
